# Handover

## Manager actions

- Email the user ID and initial password to the starter — by 16 April, four days before start
- Confirm the desk and the two office days with Facilities — by 16 April
- Brief the team and put the first-week plan in the team channel — by 17 April
- Meet the starter in reception at 09:00 on 20 April
- Arrange the first-week sessions with Cloud Operations and Information Security — by 17 April
- Confirm the on-call shadow date with the rotation owner — by 24 April
- Hold a first-week review on 24 April

## First day

Marama arrives at the Wellington office reception at 09:00 on 20 April and is met by Tomas Berg. A colleague will sign her into the building; her access card is not expected until 21 April.

The morning is the laptop, sign-in, password change and the standard Technology induction. Lunch with the team. The afternoon is a walkthrough of the container platform and the deployment path with Mereana Walker, and no expectation of anything beyond listening.

She is not on the on-call rotation and will not be until she has shadowed a full week, currently planned from 11 May. She was told this at offer.

Readiness confirmed 17 April 2026 by Tomas Berg, three days before the start date. Account created and propagated, credentials issued, device built and configured, and all software and system entitlements in place — Marama can work from her first morning. One thing is not in place: the building access card, which will not be issued until 21 April; it is recorded in `access.outstanding` and a colleague will sign her in on the first day.

## Readiness confirmation

Ready with outstanding items
